products.title: Golden Hour — Marigold Avenue
products.description: Sun-warmed soft-rock that sounds like the last hour of a long summer day — jangling twelve-strings, close harmonies, and a rhythm section that never hurries. Sequenced to play from the porch light coming on to the crickets starting up. A record made for a slow evening.
products.seoTitle: Marigold Avenue — Golden Hour (LP) | Sunset Sounds
products.seoDescription: Sun-warmed soft-rock from Marigold Avenue on 180g vinyl. Limited Sunset color pressing available.

products.title: Paper Moon Radio — The Clementine Sisters
products.description: Vintage-soul pop with three voices braided into one — handclaps, a walking bassline, and hooks that lodge for a week. It swings like an AM radio station you can’t quite find again the next morning. Warm, analogue, and impossible to sit still to.
products.seoTitle: The Clementine Sisters — Paper Moon Radio (LP) | Sunset Sounds
products.seoDescription: Vintage-soul pop from The Clementine Sisters, pressed on 180g vinyl.

products.title: Dust & Diamonds — Wendell Rhodes
products.description: Dusty-road country from a voice with gravel and honey in it — pedal steel that cries in all the right places, songs about leaving and the roads that bring you back. The kind of record that sounds even better on a rainy afternoon with the lamp on.
products.seoTitle: Wendell Rhodes — Dust & Diamonds (LP) | Sunset Sounds
products.seoDescription: Dusty-road country and americana from Wendell Rhodes on 180g vinyl.

products.title: Harbor Lights — The Ambergris Quartet
products.description: A late-night jazz session cut straight to tape — brushed drums, a bass you can lean on, and a tenor sax that leaves plenty of room to breathe. An audiophile 180g pressing that rewards a good stylus and a quiet room after everyone’s gone home.
products.seoTitle: The Ambergris Quartet — Harbor Lights (LP) | Sunset Sounds
products.seoDescription: A late-night jazz session on audiophile 180g vinyl — brushed drums, walking bass, room to breathe.

products.title: Slow Sunday — June Calloway
products.description: Deep, unhurried soul from a singer who never wastes a note — a Hammond organ that simmers, horns that punch just enough, and a voice that sounds like it’s telling you the truth. The record that clears the counter every time we drop the needle on it.
products.seoTitle: June Calloway — Slow Sunday (LP) | Sunset Sounds
products.seoDescription: Deep, unhurried soul from June Calloway on 180g vinyl.

products.title: Ferris Wheel — The Tangerine Set
products.description: Sunny psych-pop with the top down — fuzz guitars, a farfisa organ, and choruses built for a carnival at dusk. Ten tracks and not a dull one, sequenced to flip straight back over the second side B runs out. Play it loud with the windows open.
products.seoTitle: The Tangerine Set — Ferris Wheel (LP) | Sunset Sounds
products.seoDescription: Sunny psych-pop from The Tangerine Set on 180g vinyl. Limited Sunset color pressing available.

products.title: Sunset SL-70 Belt-Drive Turntable
products.description: The deck we set up for people getting back into records — a belt-drive turntable in a warm walnut plinth, with a pre-mounted cartridge and a built-in preamp, so it plugs straight into powered speakers or an amp with no fuss. An adjustable counterweight that’s actually easy to set, felt feet, and a hush to the background you’ll notice on the first play. Sounds far better than it has any right to at the price.
products.seoTitle: Sunset SL-70 Belt-Drive Turntable | Sunset Sounds
products.seoDescription: A walnut belt-drive turntable with a pre-mounted cartridge and built-in preamp — plug-and-play into powered speakers or an amp.

images.alt: The Sunset Sounds belt-drive turntable in walnut

products.title: Wool-Felt Slipmat
products.description: A soft wool-felt slipmat that sits quietly under the record and keeps static and dust from creeping in between plays. Fits any standard 12-inch platter, screen-printed with the little Sunset mark. Cheap enough to buy two and keep one clean.
products.seoTitle: Wool-Felt Slipmat — turntable accessory | Sunset Sounds
products.seoDescription: A soft wool-felt slipmat that keeps static and dust down between plays. Fits any 12-inch platter.

products.title: Record Revival Cleaning Kit
products.description: Everything to bring a tired record back to life — an anti-static carbon-fibre brush, a bottle of alcohol-free cleaning fluid, and a soft microfibre cloth, in a little tin that lives next to the deck. Two minutes before a play and most of the pops and crackle simply go away.
products.seoTitle: Record Revival Cleaning Kit — record care | Sunset Sounds
products.seoDescription: An anti-static brush, alcohol-free fluid and a microfibre cloth to bring a tired record back to life.

images.alt: A record-revival cleaning kit with brush and fluid

products.title: Sunset Canvas Record Tote
products.description: A heavy 16oz natural-canvas tote sized to carry a dozen LPs home without the corners going soft — a flat bottom, reinforced straps, and the sunset mark printed low on the side. The bag you’ll grab on the way out the door every single time.
products.seoTitle: Sunset Canvas Record Tote | Sunset Sounds
products.seoDescription: A heavy 16oz natural-canvas tote sized to carry a dozen LPs home, printed with the sunset mark.

images.alt: A natural canvas record tote bag

products.title: The Monthly Spin — Vinyl Subscription
products.description: One record in the mail every month, wrapped in brown paper and chosen by the people behind the counter to match the corners of the shop you love — a new pressing or a clean reissue we think you should hear, with the hand-written card that tells you why. Skip a month, change your taste, or cancel any time. The warmest way to keep the shelf growing.
products.seoTitle: The Monthly Spin — Vinyl Subscription | Sunset Sounds
products.seoDescription: A hand-picked record in the mail every month, wrapped in paper and matched to your taste. Skip, swap or cancel any time.
